process: Paid With Funds — Aid Tracking Post Lifecycle
description: The cooperative fund pays an approved Medical/Death Aid benefit up front. Members owe repayments to replenish the fund. The post closes only after the Treasurer -> Auditor -> President pipeline completes twice: once for the fund disbursement, once for the repayment close.

actors.name: Treasurer
actors.role: initiates actions and moves money (fund outflow on release, fund inflow on remittance); never verifies or approves

actors.name: Auditor
actors.role: verifies actions submitted by the Treasurer; can reject; never approves

actors.name: President
actors.role: gives final approval; approval of the second cycle closes the post; never verifies

states.action: Create AidTrackingPost and one Contribution per active member (NOT_PAID, expected_amount = aid / member count)
preconditions: Medical/Death Aid claim approved by President
No finish or fund request already in progress

states.action: Pay with Funds: set finish_status=pending_auditor, finish_skip_remaining=True, finish_paid_with_funds=True
preconditions: finish_status is empty (no request in progress)

transitions.trigger: Auditor verifies (decision=verified, deduction sheet NOT required for paid-with-funds)

states.action: Verify fund disbursement: no auto-skip of unpaid members (they still owe), notify President

transitions.trigger: President approves (finish_status=pending_release, unpaid members NOT skipped because paid_with_funds)

states.action: Approve disbursement: route to Treasurer for fund release
Release funds: record FundTransaction OUTFLOW = total_expected (source_type=aid_post_payment), mark Death/MedicalAid Released, post stays active

transitions.trigger: Treasurer clicks Close Repayment (remaining NOT_PAID -> SKIPPED, totals recomputed)

states.action: Collect repayments: Treasurer marks RECORDED, Auditor marks PAID; Treasurer records salary deduction remittance (FundTransaction INFLOW, source_type=salary_deduction_remittance); members may be SKIPPED

transitions.trigger: Treasurer decides repayments sufficient and closes repayment

fund_transaction.description: Salary deduction remittance ref <ref> for aid post <id> / Aid contribution - <member>

states.action: Close Repayment: skip remaining NOT_PAID contributions (SKIPPED, manual override), recompute total_collected
Verify repayments: convert RECORDED/PENDING_VERIFICATION to PAID, record per-contribution FundTransaction INFLOW (source_type=contribution, ref AID-<post>-C-<contrib>)

transitions.trigger: President approves (paid_with_funds + paid contributions exist -> close post: finish_status=approved, is_active=False)
Edge case: President approves but NO paid contributions exist -> falls back to release again

states.action: Approve repayment close: post closed (finish_status=approved, is_active=False), underlying aid stays Released, dashboards notified
preconditions: At least one paid contribution exists

states.action: Reject request: post returns to working state, Treasurer notified
preconditions: Auditor decision = rejected at cycle 1 or cycle 2

pipeline.purpose: Fund disbursement (money OUT of the fund)

steps.action: Release fund (outflow = total_expected), mark aid Released

pipeline.purpose: Repayment close (money BACK IN to the fund)

steps.action: Close Repayment (skip remaining unpaid, recompute totals)

end_states: approved (post closed, is_active=False, appears in aid post history)

money_flow.effect: Fund depleted by the aid payout
Fund replenished by salary deduction remittances

rules: Treasurer: only initiates actions and moves money; never verifies or approves
Auditor: only verifies or rejects; never approves, never closes a post
President: only approves; approval of cycle 2 closes the post
No deduction sheet required for paid-with-funds verification (fund, not member contributions, pays the aid)
Unpaid members are NOT auto-skipped at cycle 1 approval (they still owe the fund)
Remaining unpaid members are SKIPPED only when the Treasurer closes the repayment
A finish/fund request cannot be started while one is already in progress
Every money-affecting step (outflow and inflows) passes through the TAP pipeline
